description: Figure 10 illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis displays the language families, which are listed as Indo-European, Uralic, Altaic, and isolate. The vertical axis represents the effect size, with a scale ranging from -0.1 to 0.1. For each language family, there are two bars: one for the TARG model and one for the PERMUTE model, distinguished by color (TARG is blue, PERMUTE is red). Error bars, indicating the standard deviation, are present on each bar. The chart shows that for the Indo-European family, both TARG and PERMUTE have a positive effect, with TARG being slightly higher. For the Uralic family, both models show a negative effect, with PERMUTE having a larger negative effect than TARG. In the Altaic family, TARG has a positive effect while PERMUTE has a negative effect. For the isolate family, both models show a positive effect, with TARG having a larger positive effect than PERMUTE.
